subject: English
question_text: Read the following sentences and put them in correct order.
stimulus: (a) For example, once the boy set his father’s house on fire only to see how it could burn. (b) To satisfy his curiosity, he often undertook some risky adventures. (c) But at the same time, he was proud of the young boy. (d) And that was his loving mother. (e) But there was only one person who did never feel annoyed with the boy. (f) He was Thomas Alva Edison. (g) His father got angry for this kind of activity. (h) A young boy of six or seven became the subject of talk in a village because he always asked "Why, why, why".
guide_solution: h → f → b → a → g → c → e → d
